title: Radiomics and deep learning fusion model based on multiphasic CT for predicting HER2 expression status in bladder urothelial carcinoma: a multicenter study.
summary: 411 patients; tri-phasic CT radiomics and 2.5D/3D ResNet50 fusion against HER2 IHC, with independent internal and two-center external validation; external AUC 0.873. Retrospective proof of concept, not prospective treatment benefit.
